wiki.title: Bixie Battlemage
wiki.text:
The Bixie Battlemage is an enemy bixie NPC that can be found in Queensfields along the two bixie groups of pikemen and soldiers. Most bixie battlemages are Difficulty 1 enemies, they also can be found in Highroad Junction, which referred to as "Bixie Magus".
